answer_2.quote: we define three metrics: path recall, local interpretability, and global interpretability for evaluation

answer_4.quote: we invite annotators to manually annotate interpretability scores for all possible rules ... for every true path, we let the annotator choose one of the following three options, namely reasonable, partially reasonable, and unreasonable
answer_4.guideline: Annotators choose from three options: reasonable, partially reasonable, unreasonable, corresponding to interpretability scores of 1, 0.5, and 0 respectively.
